quote: It's a glorified relationship chore simulator. The main characters are very forgettable. A lot of what makes a grand theft auto game fantastic is missing or heavily restricted. It's a Girl boss pile of trash

author: Danielb82
quote: I'm loving this game. Story is fantastic, gameplay is addicting and the online feature is great for helping other players with building roads and leaving ladders and climbing rope for others to use. Everything you build show up in other players games. Very unique and interesting game.
